component.name: MCPE Launcher
component.summary: Manage and launch Minecraft: Bedrock Edition versions

description.p: A GTK4/libadwaita launcher for mcpelauncher-client. It lets you install several Minecraft: Bedrock Edition APKs side by side, validates each one (package name and x86_64 native binaries), extracts it and launches it with mcpelauncher-client.
